lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 003: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Fixed the reviewer-flagged tests-with-meaningful-assert gap in test/issues/self-contaminating-search.test.ts: the $(...) command-substitution regression test asserted on 'test $(grep -rl zzqqx scripts ) -gt 0' with a space inserted before the closing ')'. That space makes tokenize() split 'scripts' and ')' into two separate tokens, so the root token pushed for the first root is already the clean string 'scripts' -- isStoreReachingRoot matches on the FIRST root in the list and returns immediately, so the test was green regardless of whether stripTrailingShellPunctuation (the function this test claims to cover, per its own name and the surrounding code comments) does anything at all. Verified this empirically: neutered stripTrailingShellPunctuation to `return token;` unconditionally and reran the suite -- the OLD spaced-form assertion still passed (proving it was tautological for this behavior), while every other $(...)/`` `...` ``-wrapper test without the artificial space (e.g. the sh -c 'rg ... scripts/cam' case, the CAM-460 AC2 quoted-alternation case) correctly went red. Fix: changed the primary assertion to the space-free canonical form every real command actually produces, 'test $(grep -rl zzqqx scripts) -gt 0' (root token literally 'scripts)', requiring the strip to pass), and kept the originally-spaced variant as a second, separate test case immediately after it (still a legitimate shape to cover, just not evidence of the strip behavior). Restored the neutered stripTrailingShellPunctuation before committing -- no source file was touched, this was a test-only fix. Did not touch the two other review-round-2 findings already filed as separate stories (US-R2-002 already fixed the command-position gap per its own handoff; a third finding about a patterns.md overclaim, if still outstanding, is out of scope for this story -- only the notes field for US-R2-003 was in scope here). check:all is fully green: test 5873/5873 (net 0 files added, 1 test split into 2 = +1 test count vs prior handoff's 5872), typecheck ok, lint ok, embed-vendor n/a (no vendor/templates touched), file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps/skip-ratchet all ok. No pattern-records.jsonl file exists in this repo yet, so appliedPatternIds is omitted. No new patterns.md bullet added: this fix is a direct application of the already-documented oracle-falsifiability rule (patterns.md:928, CAM-372) rather than a new discovery.
